ns2:section.sectionText: Course meets on Wednesdays from 5:30pm to 8:30pm on the following dates: August 28, October 2 and 30, and November 20. Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see ttp://www.oce.illinois.edu. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers, waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC, or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC or EDM:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $582.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
